claim: The alt ROM spare block 0x386E-0x3CFF is a patch location, but it copies NextZXOS ROM3, not Sinclair's all-0xFF area, so ROM data and vectors there must stay intact.

evidence.text: NextZXOS ROM3 is not free at 0x386E: its IM 1 handler CALLs 0x386E and its UDG print JPs 0x387E.
Intro uses IM 2 with I = 3B: ROM 3BFF-3C00 is its vector; hooks must leave them FF; JNext headless found it.
192-231 ROM bytes the game runs or reads differ from Sinclair's; the ROM path check reports them.
